statement: No agreement between the two leading compute jurisdictions sets verifiable limits on training compute or capabilities (Official readouts, treaty texts; by 2028-06-30)
status_at_phase_end: Holding (toward YES) at the timeline start: the most recent leaders' meeting (pre-window, 2022-11-14) produced no AI arrangement of any kind; during the window relations on chips moved toward confrontation (new Bloc A entity listings; a Bloc B trade-dispute filing). No AI compute or capability limit was agreed or under negotiation.

items.summary: Pre-window baseline: Bloc A's official readout of a leaders' meeting with Bloc B lists cooperation on climate, macroeconomic stability, health and food security, agreement that nuclear war must never be fought, and follow-up talks on principles for managing competition; AI is not mentioned and no technology limits were agreed.
items.detail: White House readout, 'Readout of President Joe Biden's Meeting with President Xi Jinping of the Bloc B', Bali, 2022-11-14 (verified via web_extract this run; full text read).

items.summary: Pre-window baseline: Bloc B's official readout of the same meeting describes a candid exchange and instructions to teams to follow up on 'common understandings' and maintain regular contact; it records no agreement on AI compute or capability limits.
items.detail: Bloc B Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 'President Xi Jinping Meets with Bloc A. President Joe Biden in Bali', 2022-11-14 (verified via web_extract this run; middle of the long readout was truncated in extraction, so absence of any AI reference is asserted with medium confidence).

items.summary: In the window, Bloc B opened a formal trade dispute against Bloc A's advanced-chip export controls, the same day Bloc A announced new entity listings aimed at AI-chip developers: the two blocs' interaction on compute was adversarial, not limit-setting.
items.detail: WTO DS615 request for consultations circulated 2022-12-15 (verified via web_extract this run); BIS Entity List press release 2022-12-15 (see I-R1-03 items 002-004).
